title: New security-definer view inbound_email_sender_state bypasses RLS and exposes enquirer emails to the public anon key
evidence:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW inbound_email_sender_state AS
SELECT
  vacancy_id,
  lower(sender_email) AS sender_email_lc,
  bool_or(reminder_sent_at IS NULL) AS has_unreminded,
  max(reminder_sent_at) AS last_stage1_at,
  max(second_reminder_sent_at) AS last_stage2_at
FROM inbound_email
detail: Postgres views run as their owner (security definer) by default, so this migration-owned view bypasses the RLS the project auto-enables on every public table precisely to stop anon/authenticated-key reads (20260512175704_canonical_rls_auto_enable.sql). Supabase auto-exposes public-schema views via PostgREST with default SELECT grants to anon, so the shipped public anon key can read per-vacancy enquirer email addresses (PII) and reminder state unauthenticated. The migration comment "No RLS surface change" is wrong for views.
recommended_fix: Recreate the view WITH (security_invoker = on) so base-table RLS applies to non-service roles, and/or add REVOKE SELECT ON inbound_email_sender_state FROM anon, authenticated; the server role keeps full access either way.

title: New reminder code paths log full enquirer email addresses to server logs
evidence:
wisp.log_warning(
      "reminder stamp cleared for invalid legacy sender: " <> addr,
    )
...
        wisp.log_error("Follow-up send failed for " <> email <> ": " <> err)
detail: The diff adds two new log sites emitting raw applicant/enquirer email addresses (PII) into Cloud Run logs. This extends a pre-existing stage-1 pattern, but logs outlive the retention job's DB purge of enquirer PII (30 days post-close), widening the PII footprint.
recommended_fix: Redact or hash the address in these two new log lines (e.g. log a masked local part or the vacancy-scoped row id); keep the full email only in the DB clear call.
